WFSpecifiedDate.doc: Specified Day. June 29, 2007. This value depends on the value of WFDateSpecifier. This parameter is only valid when the value of "WFDateSpecifier" is "Specified Day"

getupcomingreminders.title: Get Upcoming Reminders
getupcomingreminders.desc: Gets upcoming reminders, ordered from nearest to farthest away due date

geturlcomponent.title: Get Component of URL
geturlcomponent.desc: Gets the specified part of the URL passed into the action. URLs are structured as follows: scheme://user:password@host:port/path?query#fragment

getvalueforkey.title: Get Dictionary Value
getvalueforkey.desc: Gets the value for the specified key in the dictionary passed into the action. . You can reference values deep inside of a dictionary by providing multiple keys separated by dots. For example, to get the value "soup" from the dictionary {"beverages": [{"favorite": "soup"}]}, you can specify the key path "beverages.1.favorite"

WFDictionaryKey.doc: Key. This value depends on the value of WFGetDictionaryValueType. This parameter is only valid when the value of "WFGetDictionaryValueType" is "Value"

getvariable.title: Get Variable
getvariable.desc: Gets the value of the specified variable and passes it to the next action

getwebpagecontents.title: Get Contents of Web Page
getwebpagecontents.desc: Extracts the contents of the web pages passed into the action

getwifi.title: Get Network Details
getwifi.desc: Gets information about the currently connected networks

WFWiFiDetail.doc: Get. This value depends on the value of WFNetworkDetailsNetwork. This parameter is only valid when the value of "WFNetworkDetailsNetwork" is "Wi-Fi"

WFCellularDetail.doc: Get. This value depends on the value of WFNetworkDetailsNetwork. This parameter is only valid when the value of "WFNetworkDetailsNetwork" is "Cellular"

handoff.title: Continue in Shortcuts App
handoff.desc: Switches into the Shortcuts app and continues to the next action

handoffplayback.title: Hand Off Playback
handoffplayback.desc: Hands off Music or Podcasts playback between two devices

WFSourceMediaRoute.doc: Source. The device to hand off playback from

WFDestinationMediaRoute.doc: Destination. The device to hand off playback to

hash.title: Generate Hash
hash.desc: Generates a MD5/SHA1 hash from the input

health.quantity.log.title: Log Health Sample
health.quantity.log.desc: Adds a data point into the Health app. You can log anything that the Health app supports, including your weight, steps taken, running distance, caloric intake and more

WFQuantitySampleDate.doc: Date. optional. The date and time of the data point. The current date will be used if you don't provide a date

WFSampleEndDate.doc: End Date. optional. The date and time for the end of the data point. The current date will be used if you don't provide a date

health.workout.log.title: Log Workout
health.workout.log.desc: Adds a workout into the Health app. You can log all kinds of activities, from running and cycling to playing a sport

WFWorkoutDate.doc: Date. optional. The date and time of the start of the workout

WFWorkoutDuration.doc: Duration. 30. The duration of the workout (optional)

WFWorkoutCaloriesQuantity.doc: Calories. 400. The calories burned during the activity (optional)

WFWorkoutDistanceQuantity.doc: Distance. 10. The distance covered during the activity. Only provide this if it makes sense for the activity. (optional)

hide.app.title: Hide App
hide.app.desc: Hides one or all open applications. You can choose a list of apps to keep open

WFApp.doc: App. Choose. This value depends on the value of WFHideAppMode. This parameter is only valid when the value of "WFHideAppMode" is "App"

WFAppsExcept.doc: Apps. Choose. This value depends on the value of WFHideAppMode. This parameter is only valid when the value of "WFHideAppMode" is "All Apps"

image.combine.title: Combine Images
image.combine.desc: Combines the images passed into the action horizontally, vertically, or in a grid

WFImageCombineSpacing.doc: Spacing. 0. The number of pixels of transparent space to place between consecutive images

image.convert.title: Convert Image
image.convert.desc: Converts the images passed into the action to the specified image format

WFImageCompressionQuality.doc: Quality. Allows you to choose the image quality used when compressing the image file. Higher quality images will look better, but result in larger files. This value depends on the value of WFImageFormat. This parameter is only valid when the value of "WFImageFormat" is "JPEG"

WFImagePreserveMetadata.doc: Preserve Metadata. When Preserve Metadata is turned off, all metadata, such as the GPS coordinates where the photo was taken, will be stripped from the image file. This value depends on the value of WFImageFormat. This parameter is only valid when the value of "WFImageFormat" is "JPEG", "PNG", "TIFF", "HEIF", "Match Input"

image.crop.title: Crop Image
image.crop.desc: Crops images to a smaller rectangle

WFImageCropPosition.doc: Position. Where on the original image the crop should occur

WFImageCropX.doc: X Coordinate. 0. This value depends on the value of WFImageCropPosition. This parameter is only valid when the value of "WFImageCropPosition" is "Custom"

WFImageCropY.doc: Y Coordinate. 0. This value depends on the value of WFImageCropPosition. This parameter is only valid when the value of "WFImageCropPosition" is "Custom"

image.flip.title: Flip Image
image.flip.desc: Reverses the direction of images either horizontally or vertically

image.mask.title: Mask Image
image.mask.desc: Applies a mask to each image passed into the action. For example, you can cut images into a rounded rectangle, ellipse or icon shape, or provide a custom alpha mask

WFMaskCornerRadius.doc: Corner Radius. 0. A radius to apply to each corner of the source image in pixels. This value depends on the value of WFMaskType. This parameter is only valid when the value of "WFMaskType" is "Rounded Rectangle"

WFCustomMaskImage.doc: Custom Image. Image. An alpha mask to apply to the source image, where darker colors become transparent and lighter colors remain opaque. If the mask is sized differently than the source image, the mask is resized to match the dimensions of the source image. This value depends on the value of WFMaskType. This parameter is only valid when the value of "WFMaskType" is "Custom Image"

image.removebackground.title: Remove Image Background
image.removebackground.desc: Removes the background from an image, keeping the subjects

WFCropToBounds.doc: Crop. If turned on, the resulting image will be cropped to its bounds. If turned off, the original bounds will be kept

image.resize.title: Resize Image
image.resize.desc: Scales images to a particular width and height. If the width or height is not set, that dimension is automatically calculated to maintain the original image's aspect ratio

WFImageResizeWidth.doc: Width. Auto Width. This value depends on the value of WFImageResizeKey. This parameter is only valid when the value of "WFImageResizeKey" is "Size"

WFImageResizeHeight.doc: Height. Auto Height. This value depends on the value of WFImageResizeKey. This parameter is only valid when the value of "WFImageResizeKey" is "Size"

WFImageResizePercentage.doc: Percentage. 100. This value depends on the value of WFImageResizeKey. This parameter is only valid when the value of "WFImageResizeKey" is "Percentage"

WFImageResizeLength.doc: Longest Edge Size. 640. This value depends on the value of WFImageResizeKey. This parameter is only valid when the value of "WFImageResizeKey" is "Longest Edge"

image.rotate.title: Rotate Image/Video
image.rotate.desc: Turns an image or video clockwise by a particular number of degrees

importaudiofiles.title: Import Audio Files into Music
importaudiofiles.desc: Imports audio files into Music and compresses them with the chosen encoder

WFImportAudioFilesEncoder.doc: Encoder. This value depends on the value of WFImportAudioFilesReencode. This parameter is only valid when the value of "WFImportAudioFilesReencode" is True

intercom.title: Intercom
intercom.desc: Announces a message passed as input using Intercom. This action accepts both text and media files as input. Media files will be broadcast as they are. When text is provided, it will be first converted to audio using the current Siri language and voice. You can also use the Make Spoken Audio From Text action to customize the voice parameters

WFInput.doc: Message. Dinner is ready!. The message to announce using Intercom. Any input exceeding 60 seconds in duration will be trimmed

list.title: List
list.desc: Allows you to specify a list of items to be passed to the next action. If you specify a variable, the contents of that variable will be included in the list

listeningmode.set.title: Set Noise Control Mode
listeningmode.set.desc: Uses OCR to extract text from an image

location.title: Location
location.desc: Passes the specified location to the next action

lockscreen.title: Lock Screen
lockscreen.desc: Locks the screen of this device

lowpowermode.set.title: Set Low Power Mode
lowpowermode.set.desc: Finds a note using the specified criteria and appends the input to the note

makegif.title: Make GIF
makegif.desc: Creates an animated GIF from the images or video passed into the action

WFMakeGIFActionLoopCount.doc: This value depends on the value of WFMakeGIFActionLoopEnabled. This parameter is only valid when the value of "WFMakeGIFActionLoopEnabled" is False

WFMakeGIFActionManualSizeWidth.doc: Width. 500. This value depends on the value of WFMakeGIFActionAutoSize. This parameter is only valid when the value of "WFMakeGIFActionAutoSize" is False

WFMakeGIFActionManualSizeHeight.doc: Height. 500. This value depends on the value of WFMakeGIFActionAutoSize. This parameter is only valid when the value of "WFMakeGIFActionAutoSize" is False

makeimagefrompdfpage.title: Make Image from PDF Page
makeimagefrompdfpage.desc: Creates images from the pages in the PDF passed into the action

makeimagefromrichtext.title: Make Image from Rich Text
makeimagefromrichtext.desc: Creates an image from the rich text, web content, or URL passed in as input

makepdf.title: Make PDF
makepdf.desc: Makes a PDF out of the input. The resulting PDF can optionally include a quarter-inch margin for better printing

WFPDFSinglePage.doc: Page #. 1. This value depends on the value of WFPDFIncludedPages. This parameter is only valid when the value of "WFPDFIncludedPages" is "Single Page"

WFPDFPageRangeStart.doc: Start Page #. 1. This value depends on the value of WFPDFIncludedPages. This parameter is only valid when the value of "WFPDFIncludedPages" is "Page Range"

WFPDFPageRangeEnd.doc: End Page #. 3. This value depends on the value of WFPDFIncludedPages. This parameter is only valid when the value of "WFPDFIncludedPages" is "Page Range"

WFPDFDocumentMergeBehavior.doc: Merge Behavior. Merge documents by appending or shuffling pages. Shuffling will add one page from each of the passed documents to the new document, then proceed to take the next page from each passed document, until all pages in the passed documents have been added to the new document

makespokenaudiofromtext.title: Make Spoken Audio from Text
makespokenaudiofromtext.desc: Creates an audio file from text, using text-to-speech

makevideofromgif.title: Make Video from GIF
makevideofromgif.desc: Converts an animated GIF into a video

makezip.title: Make Archive
makezip.desc: Makes an archive out of the files passed as input. Supports creating zip, tar.gz, tar.bz2, tar.xz, tar, gzip, cpio, or iso archives

math.title: Calculate
math.desc: Performs a number operation on the input and returns the result

WFScientificMathOperation.doc: Scientific Operation. This value depends on the value of WFMathOperation. This parameter is only valid when the value of "WFMathOperation" is "…"

WFMathOperand.doc: Operand. Number. This value depends on the value of WFMathOperation. This parameter is only valid when the value of "WFMathOperation" is "…"

WFScientificMathOperand.doc: Operand. Number. This value depends on the value of WFMathOperation. This parameter is only valid when the value of "WFMathOperation" is "…". This value depends on the value of WFScientificMathOperation. This parameter is only valid when the value of "WFScientificMathOperation" is "Modulus", "x^y"

measurement.convert.title: Convert Measurement
measurement.convert.desc: Converts the measurements passed into the action to the specified unit

measurement.create.title: Measurement
measurement.create.desc: Passes the specified measurement (including number and unit) to the next action

movewindow.title: Move Window
movewindow.desc: Moves one or more windows to the specified location

WFXCoordinate.doc: X. This value depends on the value of WFPosition. This parameter is only valid when the value of "WFPosition" is "Coordinates"

WFYCoordinate.doc: Y. This value depends on the value of WFPosition. This parameter is only valid when the value of "WFPosition" is "Coordinates"

Display.doc: Display. Current Display. The display to move the window to

nightshift.set.title: Set nightshift
nightshift.set.desc: Passes a random number between the given minimum and maximum to the next action. The minimum and maximum numbers are included as possible results

nothing.title: Nothing
nothing.desc: This action does nothing and produces no output. It is useful to separate blocks of actions, or to explicitly pass an empty input to an action

WFInput.doc: Attachment. Choose Variable. An image or video to include in the notification

number.title: Number
number.desc: Passes a number to the next action

number.random.title: Random Number
number.random.desc: Passes a random number between the given minimum and maximum to the next action. The minimum and maximum numbers are included as possible results

WFAppIdentifier.doc: Bundle ID of the app, e.g. com.apple.mobilesafari.

openin.title: Open File
openin.desc: Opens the input as a file in the specified app

WFSelectedApp.doc: App. Default App. This value depends on the value of WFOpenInAskWhenRun. This parameter is only valid when the value of "WFOpenInAskWhenRun" is False

openurl.title: Open URLs
openurl.desc: Opens URLs passed into the action in Safari

openworkflow.title: Open Shortcut
openworkflow.desc: Opens a shortcut in the Shortcuts editor

openxcallbackurl.title: Open X-Callback URL
openxcallbackurl.desc: Performs the specified x-callback-url action. The x-success, x-cancel, and x-error parameters will be added automatically

WFXCallbackCustomCallbackEnabled.doc: Custom Callback. Turn this on if you want to open a callback URL that is not x-callback-url compliant and uses keys other than “x-success”, “x-error”, and “x-cancel”

WFXCallbackCustomSuccessKey.doc: Success Key. This value depends on the value of WFXCallbackCustomCallbackEnabled. This parameter is only valid when the value of "WFXCallbackCustomCallbackEnabled" is True

WFXCallbackCustomCancelKey.doc: Cancel Key. optional. This value depends on the value of WFXCallbackCustomCallbackEnabled. This parameter is only valid when the value of "WFXCallbackCustomCallbackEnabled" is True

WFXCallbackCustomErrorKey.doc: Error Key. optional. This value depends on the value of WFXCallbackCustomCallbackEnabled. This parameter is only valid when the value of "WFXCallbackCustomCallbackEnabled" is True

WFXCallbackCustomSuccessURLEnabled.doc: Custom X-Success URL. If enabled, Shortcuts will use a custom success callback URL. This is useful if the app you are calling uses placeholders in the x-success URL to pass output

WFXCallbackCustomSuccessURL.doc: X-Success URL. For example, you might use shortcuts://callback?result=[[output]]. This value depends on the value of WFXCallbackCustomSuccessURLEnabled. This parameter is only valid when the value of "WFXCallbackCustomSuccessURLEnabled" is True

orientationlock.set.title: Set Orientation Lock
orientationlock.set.desc: Encodes or decodes text or files using Base64 encoding

output.title: Stop and Output
output.desc: Stops execution of the current shortcut, and outputs content. This action is useful when:

WFResponse.doc: Result. This value depends on the value of WFNoOutputSurfaceBehavior. This parameter is only valid when the value of "WFNoOutputSurfaceBehavior" is "Respond"

overlayimageonimage.title: Overlay Image
overlayimageonimage.desc: Overlays an image on top of another image

WFImagePosition.doc: Position. This value depends on the value of WFShouldShowImageEditor. This parameter is only valid when the value of "WFShouldShowImageEditor" is False

WFImageWidth.doc: Width. Auto. This value depends on the value of WFShouldShowImageEditor. This parameter is only valid when the value of "WFShouldShowImageEditor" is False

WFImageHeight.doc: Height. Auto. This value depends on the value of WFShouldShowImageEditor. This parameter is only valid when the value of "WFShouldShowImageEditor" is False

WFImageX.doc: X Coordinate. 0. This value depends on the value of WFShouldShowImageEditor. This parameter is only valid when the value of "WFShouldShowImageEditor" is False. This value depends on the value of WFImagePosition. This parameter is only valid when the value of "WFImagePosition" is "Custom"

WFImageY.doc: Y Coordinate. 0. This value depends on the value of WFShouldShowImageEditor. This parameter is only valid when the value of "WFShouldShowImageEditor" is False. This value depends on the value of WFImagePosition. This parameter is only valid when the value of "WFImagePosition" is "Custom"

WFRotation.doc: Rotation (Degrees). 0. This value depends on the value of WFShouldShowImageEditor. This parameter is only valid when the value of "WFShouldShowImageEditor" is False

WFOverlayImageOpacity.doc: Opacity. 100%. This value depends on the value of WFShouldShowImageEditor. This parameter is only valid when the value of "WFShouldShowImageEditor" is False

overlaytext.title: Overlay Text
overlaytext.desc: Overlays text onto the image passed as input

WFTextX.doc: X Coordinate. 0. The X Coordinate to start the text at, in points. 0 starts at the left of the image. This value depends on the value of WFSizingMethod. This parameter is only valid when the value of "WFSizingMethod" is "Absolute". This value depends on the value of WFTextPosition. This parameter is only valid when the value of "WFTextPosition" is "Custom Position"

WFPercentageTextX.doc: X Coordinate. 0. The X Coordinate to start the text at, as a decimal proportion of the image size between 0 and 1. 0 starts at the left of the image. This value depends on the value of WFSizingMethod. This parameter is only valid when the value of "WFSizingMethod" is "Proportional". This value depends on the value of WFTextPosition. This parameter is only valid when the value of "WFTextPosition" is "Custom Position"

WFTextY.doc: Y Coordinate. 0. The Y Coordinate to start the text at, in points. 0 starts at the top of the image. This value depends on the value of WFSizingMethod. This parameter is only valid when the value of "WFSizingMethod" is "Absolute". This value depends on the value of WFTextPosition. This parameter is only valid when the value of "WFTextPosition" is "Custom Position"

WFPercentageTextY.doc: Y Coordinate. 0. The Y Coordinate to start the text at, as a decimal proportion of the image size between 0 and 1. 0 starts at the top of the image. This value depends on the value of WFSizingMethod. This parameter is only valid when the value of "WFSizingMethod" is "Proportional". This value depends on the value of WFTextPosition. This parameter is only valid when the value of "WFTextPosition" is "Custom Position"

WFTextOffset.doc: Offset. The amount of additional space between the text box and the nearest edges of the image, in points. For example, the nearest edges are the Left for Middle Left alignment, the Bottom and Right for Bottom Right alignment, and the Top for Top alignment. This value depends on the value of WFSizingMethod. This parameter is only valid when the value of "WFSizingMethod" is "Absolute". This value depends on the value of WFTextPosition. This parameter is only valid when the value of "WFTextPosition" is "Center". This value depends on the value of WFTextPosition. This parameter is only valid when the value of "WFTextPosition" is "Custom Position"

WFPercentageTextOffset.doc: Offset. The amount of additional space between the text box and the nearest edges of the image, as a decimal proportion of the image size between 0 and 1. For example, the nearest edges are the Left for Middle Left alignment, the Bottom and Right for Bottom Right alignment, and the Top for Top alignment. This value depends on the value of WFSizingMethod. This parameter is only valid when the value of "WFSizingMethod" is "Proportional". This value depends on the value of WFTextPosition. This parameter is only valid when the value of "WFTextPosition" is "Center". This value depends on the value of WFTextPosition. This parameter is only valid when the value of "WFTextPosition" is "Custom Position"

WFFontSize.doc: Font Size. The size of the font, in points, to apply to the text. This value depends on the value of WFSizingMethod. This parameter is only valid when the value of "WFSizingMethod" is "Absolute"

WFPercentageFontSize.doc: Font Size. The size of the font, as a decimal proportion of the image size between 0 and 1, to apply to the text. This value depends on the value of WFSizingMethod. This parameter is only valid when the value of "WFSizingMethod" is "Proportional"

WFTextAlignment.doc: Text Alignment. The alignment to apply to the text. This will align to the edge of the bounding box created by the Maximum Width, if any

WFTextRotation.doc: Rotation. The amount of rotation, in degrees, to apply to the text. Starts from the center of the text bounds. Optional

WFTextStrokeWidth.doc: Stroke Width. The stroke width, in points, to apply to the text. Optional. This value depends on the value of WFSizingMethod. This parameter is only valid when the value of "WFSizingMethod" is "Absolute". This value depends on the value of WFTextOutlineEnabled. This parameter is only valid when the value of "WFTextOutlineEnabled" is True

WFPercentageTextStrokeWidth.doc: Stroke Width. The stroke width, as a decimal proportion of the font size between 0 and 1, to apply to the text. Optional. This value depends on the value of WFSizingMethod. This parameter is only valid when the value of "WFSizingMethod" is "Proportional". This value depends on the value of WFTextOutlineEnabled. This parameter is only valid when the value of "WFTextOutlineEnabled" is True

WFTextStrokeColor.doc: Stroke Color. This value depends on the value of WFTextOutlineEnabled. This parameter is only valid when the value of "WFTextOutlineEnabled" is True

WFTextBoxWidth.doc: Maximum Width. The maximum width of the text, in points. If 0, the text will have a bounding box that is as wide as necessary, and may run off the edge of the image. Otherwise, the text will wrap within the bounds of the width. Optional. This value depends on the value of WFSizingMethod. This parameter is only valid when the value of "WFSizingMethod" is "Absolute"

WFPercentageTextBoxWidth.doc: Maximum Width. The maximum width of the text, as a decimal proportion of the image size between 0 and 1. If 0, the text will have a bounding box that is as wide as necessary, and may run off the edge of the image. Otherwise, the text will wrap within the bounds of the width. Optional. This value depends on the value of WFSizingMethod. This parameter is only valid when the value of "WFSizingMethod" is "Proportional"

WFSizingMethod.doc: Sizing. The sizing method to use. Proportional sizing will cause all parameters to use a decimal proportion between 0 and 1. Absolute sizing will cause all parameters to use points

pausemusic.title: Play/Pause
pausemusic.desc: Plays or pauses the currently playing media

personalhotspot.password.get.title: Get Hotspot Password
personalhotspot.password.get.desc: Returns the password of your Personal Hotspot

personalhotspot.set.title: Set personalhotspot
personalhotspot.set.desc: Sets the device's Personal Hotspot to on or off. When turning Personal Hotspot on, this action will make the hotspot discoverable for only a short period of time, in order to preserve battery life

phonenumber.title: Phone Number
phonenumber.desc: Passes the specified phone numbers to the next action

WFPhoneNumber.doc: Phone Number. Type in a phone number

photos.createalbum.title: Create Photo Album
photos.createalbum.desc: Creates a new album in the Photos app, including the specified photos and videos

AlbumName.doc: Album Name. If there is already a photo album by this name, photos will be added to the existing album instead of creating a new one

WFInput.doc: Photos. Photos, videos, or audio to include in the new album

playmusic.title: Play Music
playmusic.desc: Plays music using the Music app

WFMediaItems.doc: Music. Selects music to start playing. The music to be played

playpodcast.title: Play Podcast
playpodcast.desc: Plays a podcast using the Podcasts app

WFPodcastShow.doc: Podcast. The podcast to be played

playsound.title: Play Sound
playsound.desc: Plays the audio file passed as input, or a default notification sound if no audio file was passed

podcasts.subscribe.title: Follow Podcast
podcasts.subscribe.desc: Follows podcasts or podcast feed URLs passed into the action

posters.get.title: Get All Wallpapers
posters.get.desc: Gets all of your Lock Screen wallpapers, and returns them as output so you can use them with other actions

posters.switch.title: Switch Between Wallpapers
posters.switch.desc: Switches the current Lock Screen wallpaper. If the wallpaper has a linked Focus, this action will set the Focus, too

previewdocument.title: Quick Look
previewdocument.desc: Displays a preview of the input using the system Quick Look

properties.appstore.title: Get Details of App Store App
properties.appstore.desc: Uses the microphone to record audio

properties.articles.title: Get Details of Article
properties.articles.desc: Sets the device's Personal Hotspot to on or off. When turning Personal Hotspot on, this action will make the hotspot discoverable for only a short period of time, in order to preserve battery life

properties.calendarevents.title: Get Details of Calendar Events
properties.calendarevents.desc: Passes the contents of the clipboard to the next action

properties.contacts.title: Get Details of Contacts
properties.contacts.desc: Gets upcoming reminders, ordered from nearest to farthest away due date

properties.files.title: Get Details of Files
properties.files.desc: Passes the specified text to the next action

properties.health.quantity.title: Get Details of Health Sample
properties.health.quantity.desc: Gets the current content on screen, if available

properties.itunesartist.title: Get Details of iTunes Artist
properties.itunesartist.desc: Returns any email addresses found in the output from the previous action

properties.itunesstore.title: Get Details of iTunes Product
properties.itunesstore.desc: Creates a new album in the Photos app, including the specified photos and videos

properties.locations.title: Get Details of Locations
properties.locations.desc: Takes the inputted HTML and turns it into rich text, which can then be converted to other formats

properties.podcast.title: Get Details of Podcast Episode
properties.podcast.desc: Quits one or all open applications. You can choose a list of apps to keep open

properties.podcastshow.title: Get Details of Podcast
properties.podcastshow.desc: Turns an image or video clockwise by a particular number of degrees

properties.reminders.title: Get Details of Reminders
properties.reminders.desc: Gets bookmarks in your Pinboard account

properties.safariwebpage.title: Get Details of Safari Web Page
properties.safariwebpage.desc: Creates an animated GIF from the images or video passed into the action. Safari Web Page items are only available when running your shortcut as an Action Extension in Safari

properties.weather.conditions.title: Get Details of Weather Conditions
properties.weather.conditions.desc: Displays a dialog prompting the user to enter a piece of information

quit.app.title: Quit App
quit.app.desc: Quits one or all open applications. You can choose a list of apps to keep open

WFAppsExcept.doc: Apps. Choose. This value depends on the value of WFQuitAppMode. This parameter is only valid when the value of "WFQuitAppMode" is "All Apps"

WFApp.doc: App. Choose. This value depends on the value of WFQuitAppMode. This parameter is only valid when the value of "WFQuitAppMode" is "App"

readinglist.title: Add to Reading List
readinglist.desc: Adds URLs passed into the action to your reading list

reboot.title: Shut Down
reboot.desc: Shuts down or restarts your device

recordaudio.title: Record Audio
recordaudio.desc: Uses the microphone to record audio

WFRecordingCompression.doc: Audio Quality. High-quality audio takes up a lot more space than normal audio, so stick with normal unless you really need it. Normal audio is returned as an M4A file (with AAC audio), while high-quality audio is returned in uncompressed WAV format

WFRecordingTimeInterval.doc: Duration. This value depends on the value of WFRecordingEnd. This parameter is only valid when the value of "WFRecordingEnd" is "After Time"

reminders.showlist.title: Open Reminders List
reminders.showlist.desc: Shows the specified list in the Reminders app

removeevents.title: Remove Events
removeevents.desc: Removes all events passed into the action from the calendars they are contained in. This is a destructive and permanent action. You will be asked to confirm before events are removed

WFCalendarIncludeFutureEvents.doc: Include Future Events. When enabled, any repeats of an event in the future are also removed

removefromalbum.title: Remove from Photo Album
removefromalbum.desc: Removes the photos or videos passed as input from the specified photo album

removereminders.title: Remove Reminders
removereminders.desc: Removes all reminders passed into the action from the lists they are contained in. This is a destructive and permanent action. You will be asked to confirm before reminders are removed

round.title: Round Number
round.desc: Rounds the number(s) passed into the action

TenToThePowerOf.doc: Ten to the Power of. This value depends on the value of WFRoundTo. This parameter is only valid when the value of "WFRoundTo" is "10 ^"

rss.title: Get Items from RSS Feed
rss.desc: Downloads the latest items from an RSS feed

rss.extract.title: Get RSS Feeds from Page
rss.extract.desc: Extracts any RSS feed URLs from the given web URLs or web page

runextension.title: Share with Apps
runextension.desc: Prompts to share the input using action extensions and sharing extensions provided by other apps

runjavascriptonwebpage.title: Run JavaScript
runjavascriptonwebpage.desc: Runs JavaScript on a Safari web page passed in as input. Safari Web Page items are only available when running your shortcut as an Action Extension in Safari

runworkflow.title: Run Shortcut
runworkflow.desc: Runs a shortcut from your shortcut

WFInput.doc: Input to pass to the shortcut.

WFWorkflowName.doc: Name of the shortcut to run, exactly as it appears in Shortcuts.

safari.geturl.title: Get Current Web Page from Safari
safari.geturl.desc: Gets the web page of the frontmost Safari window

savetocameraroll.title: Save to Photo Album
savetocameraroll.desc: Adds the photos and videos passed as input to the specified photo album. If a photo passed as input is already in the specified album, the photo will be duplicated

WFInput.doc: Input. Photos, videos, or audio to save

scanbarcode.title: Scan QR or Barcode
scanbarcode.desc: Scans a QR code or barcode using the camera, and returns the text/URL that is found

searchappstore.title: Find App Store Apps
searchappstore.desc: Searches the App Store, returning the apps that match the specified search terms. You can get more details about the results using the Get Details of App Store App action

searchitunes.title: Find iTunes Store Items
searchitunes.desc: Searches the iTunes Store, returning the items that match the specified search terms. You can get more details about the results using the Get Details of iTunes Product action

searchlocalbusinesses.title: Find Places
searchlocalbusinesses.desc: Finds nearby places using Maps, and returns the results

WFInput.doc: Location. A location to search near

WFSearchQuery.doc: Search. Places. Keywords used to search for places

searchmaps.title: Open in Maps
searchmaps.desc: Opens your choice of Maps, Google Maps, or Waze and searches for the location, place, or text that was passed into the action

searchpodcasts.title: Find Podcasts
searchpodcasts.desc: Finds podcasts in the Apple Podcasts catalog, returning the items that match the specified search terms

searchweb.title: Search Web
searchweb.desc: Searches the web for the text provided as input

seek.title: Seek
seek.desc: Seek to a specific time, or forward and backward by some duration, in the currently playing media

selectcontacts.title: Select Contact
selectcontacts.desc: Prompts to pick a person from your contacts and passes the selection to the next action

selectemail.title: Select Email Address
selectemail.desc: Prompts to pick an email address from your contacts and passes the selection to the next action

selectphone.title: Select Phone Number
selectphone.desc: Prompts to pick a phone number from your contacts and passes the selection to the next action

selectphoto.title: Select Photos
selectphoto.desc: Prompts to choose photos and videos from your photo library

sendemail.title: Send Email
sendemail.desc: Presents an email composer. Pass text into the action to set the email body. Other types of input are added as attachments

WFEmailAccountActionSelectedAccount.doc: From. This value depends on the value of WFSendEmailActionShowComposeSheet. This parameter is only valid when the value of "WFSendEmailActionShowComposeSheet" is False

WFSendEmailActionFrom.doc: From. optional. The email address to send from. This must be an email address that is set up in the Mail app. This value depends on the value of WFSendEmailActionShowComposeSheet. This parameter is only valid when the value of "WFSendEmailActionShowComposeSheet" is True

WFSendEmailActionSaveAsDraft.doc: Save as Draft. This value depends on the value of WFSendEmailActionShowComposeSheet. This parameter is only valid when the value of "WFSendEmailActionShowComposeSheet" is False

sendmessage.title: Send Message
sendmessage.desc: Sends a message. Pass images, videos, or other files as input to include attachments

setairdropreceiving.title: Set AirDrop Receiving
setairdropreceiving.desc: Replaces some text passed into the action with other text

setbrightness.title: Set Brightness
setbrightness.desc: Shows the web URL passed into the action in a Safari View Controller, allowing you to view the web page without switching apps

setclipboard.title: Copy to Clipboard
setclipboard.desc: Copies the result of the last action to the clipboard

WFLocalOnly.doc: Local Only. When enabled, the input will only be copied locally, and will not be shared to other devices via Handoff

WFExpirationDate.doc: Expire At. Today at 3 PM. When set, the clipboard contents will expire and be automatically deleted at the specified time. Optional

setitemname.title: Set Name
setitemname.desc: Sets the name of the item passed as input

WFDontIncludeFileExtension.doc: Don't Include File Extension. By default, Shortcuts will automatically include a file extension if one isn't specified. Turn this on if you want to create a file with no extension

setparkedcar.title: Set Parked Car
setparkedcar.desc: Saves details of your Parked Car in the Maps app

WFLocation.doc: Location. The location of the car

WFSetParkedCarNotes.doc: Notes. Optional text that will be stored along with your parked car

WFImage.doc: Image. An optional image of the location where you parked the car

setplaybackdestination.title: Change Playback Destination
setplaybackdestination.desc: Changes the current playback destination. Use this action to route audio to AirPods, Bluetooth speakers, HomePod, or other AirPlay devices. Optionally, this action can add or remove devices from a group, so you can route audio to multiple devices at once. When attempting to add a device that does not support groups, all other devices are removed as playback destinations first

WFMediaRoute.doc: Device. The device that is set, added, or removed as playback destination

setters.calendarevents.title: Edit Calendar Event
setters.calendarevents.desc: Shows the date or calendar event passed as input in the Calendar app

setters.contacts.title: Edit Contact
setters.contacts.desc: Gets upcoming calendar events, ordered from nearest to farthest away in time

setters.reminders.title: Edit Reminder
setters.reminders.desc: Turns an image or video clockwise by a particular number of degrees

setvalueforkey.title: Set Dictionary Value
setvalueforkey.desc: Sets a value in the dictionary passed into the action

setvolume.title: Set Volume
setvolume.desc: Sets the volume of the device

WFVolumeSetting.doc: Volume Setting. The volume setting to change, either Media or Ringtone

WFVolume.doc: Volume. If you set the volume using a variable, use a number between 0 and 1 (for example, pass 0.5 for half volume)

showdefinition.title: Show Definition
showdefinition.desc: Shows the definition of the word passed into the action

showincalendar.title: Open in Calendar
showincalendar.desc: Shows the date or calendar event passed as input in the Calendar app

showinstore.title: Show in iTunes Store
showinstore.desc: Shows the iTunes products or App Store apps passed as input in a store sheet. This is useful with the Find iTunes Store Items and Find App Store Apps actions

showresult.title: Show Result
showresult.desc: Shows a preview of the provided content. If run from Siri, speaks the provided text

showwebpage.title: Show Web View
showwebpage.desc: Shows the web URL passed into the action in a Safari View Controller, allowing you to view the web page without switching apps

WFEnterSafariReader.doc: Enter Safari Reader. Enter Safari Reader mode if it’s available for the given web page

silenceunknowncallers.set.title: Set silence unknown callers
silenceunknowncallers.set.desc: Returns any street addresses found in the output from the previous action

skipback.title: Skip Back
skipback.desc: Skips to the previous song in the current music queue

skipforward.title: Skip Forward
skipforward.desc: Skips to the next song in the current music queue

splitpdf.title: Split PDF Into Pages
splitpdf.desc: Splits the input document by creating a PDF for each page

splitscreen.title: Split Screen Apps
splitscreen.desc: Open the specified apps in split screen mode

startscreensaver.title: Start Screen Saver
startscreensaver.desc: Starts the screen saver selected in the Desktop & Screen Saver preference pane

statistics.title: Calculate Statistics
statistics.desc: Calculates statistics on the numbers that are provided as input

takephoto.title: Take Photo
takephoto.desc: Uses the camera to take photos

WFPhotoCount.doc: This value depends on the value of WFCameraCaptureShowPreview. This parameter is only valid when the value of "WFCameraCaptureShowPreview" is True

takescreenshot.title: Take Screenshot
takescreenshot.desc: Take a screenshot of the device's screen

WFTakeScreenshotActionInteractiveSelecti.doc: Selection. This value depends on the value of WFTakeScreenshotScreenshotType. This parameter is only valid when the value of "WFTakeScreenshotScreenshotType" is "Interactive"

WFTakeScreenshotMainMonitorOnly.doc: Capture Main Display Only. This value depends on the value of WFTakeScreenshotScreenshotType. This parameter is only valid when the value of "WFTakeScreenshotScreenshotType" is "Full Screen"

takevideo.title: Take Video
takevideo.desc: Uses the camera to take a video clip

text.changecase.title: Change Text Case
text.changecase.desc: Skips to the previous song in the current music queue

text.combine.title: Combine Text
text.combine.desc: Gets recent notes from Evernote, optionally filtering based on criteria

text.match.title: Match Text
text.match.desc: Prompts to select files or folders

text.match.getgroup.title: Get Group from Matched Text
text.match.getgroup.desc: Quits one or all open applications. You can choose a list of apps to keep open

WFGroupIndex.doc: This value depends on the value of WFGetGroupType. This parameter is only valid when the value of "WFGetGroupType" is "Group At Index"

text.replace.title: Replace Text
text.replace.desc: Replaces some text passed into the action with other text

WFReplaceTextFind.doc: Find Text. Hello. The text to be replaced

WFReplaceTextReplace.doc: Replace With. World. The text to replace all occurrences of Find Text

WFReplaceTextCaseSensitive.doc: Case Sensitive. When disabled, the capitalization of letters is ignored

WFReplaceTextRegularExpression.doc: Regular Expression. When enabled, Find Text is treated as a regular expression

WFTextCustomSeparator.doc: Text). This value depends on the value of WFTextSeparator. This parameter is only valid when the value of "WFTextSeparator" is "Custom"

text.translate.title: Translate Text
text.translate.desc: Translates the text passed into the action into another language

timer.start.title: Start Timer
timer.start.desc: Starts a timer in the Clock app for the specified amount of time

trimvideo.title: Trim Media
trimvideo.desc: Presents a view allowing you to trim the media passed into the action

WFInputMedia.doc: Media. The audio or video file to edit

truetone.set.title: Set truetone
truetone.set.desc: Passes the specified URL to the next action

unzip.title: Extract Archive
unzip.desc: Extracts files from the archive passed as input. Many archive formats are supported, including zip, rar, tar.gz, tar.bz2, tar, gzip, cpio, cab, and iso archives

url.title: URL
url.desc: Passes the specified URL to the next action

url.expand.title: Expand URL
url.expand.desc: This action expands and cleans up URLs which have been shortened using a URL shortening service like TinyURL or Bit.ly. The expanded URL is cleaned, removing unnecessary parameters such as "utm_source"

url.getheaders.title: Get Headers of URL
url.getheaders.desc: Retrieves the HTTP headers of the URL passed as input using a HEAD request

urlencode.title: URL Encode
urlencode.desc: Encodes or decodes text passed into the action to be suitable for inclusion in a URL by adding or removing percent escapes when appropriate

vibrate.title: Vibrate Device
vibrate.desc: Vibrates the device for a short amount of time

WFVibrateHapticType.doc: Haptic Pattern. When run on Apple Watch, the selected pattern will be tapped on to your wrist

viewresult.title: View Content Graph
viewresult.desc: Shows the results of the previous action in the Content Graph

vpn.set.title: Set VPN
vpn.set.desc: Connects, disconnects or changes the On Demand setting for a VPN Configuration on this device. VPN Configurations can be set up in the Settings app. On macOS, you must authenticate as an administrator to change the On Demand setting for a VPN Configuration

WFOnDemandValue.doc: Set On Demand To. This value depends on the value of WFVPNOperation. This parameter is only valid when the value of "WFVPNOperation" is "Set On Demand"

WFVPN.doc: VPN. The VPN that will be configured by running this action

waittoreturn.title: Wait to Return
waittoreturn.desc: Pauses execution until you leave the Shortcuts app and return to it

wallpaper.set.title: Set Wallpaper Photo
wallpaper.set.desc: Sets the wallpaper to the specified image

WFWallpaperPerspectiveZoom.doc: Perspective Zoom. This value depends on the value of WFWallpaperShowPreview. This parameter is only valid when the value of "WFWallpaperShowPreview" is False

WFWallpaperLegibilityBlur.doc: Legibility Blur. This value depends on the value of WFWallpaperLocation. This parameter is only valid when the value of "WFWallpaperLocation" is "Lock Screen"

weather.currentconditions.title: Get Current Weather
weather.currentconditions.desc: Gets the current weather conditions at the specified location

weather.forecast.title: Get Weather Forecast
weather.forecast.desc: Gets an hourly or daily weather forecast at the specified location

wifi.set.title: Set Wi-Fi
wifi.set.desc: Gets the specified part of the URL passed into the action. URLs are structured as follows: scheme://user:password@host:port/path?query#fragment

workout.end.title: End Workout
workout.end.desc: Ends the active workout on your Apple Watch

workout.start.title: Start Workout
workout.start.desc: Starts a workout on your Apple Watch
